hypothesis_input: hyp-tnbc-001-v2-refined: Constitutional BRCA1 methylation (~20.6% TNBC, PMID 41654537) creates biallelic epigenetic HRD phenotype functionally equivalent to germline BRCA1 mutation but excluded from PARPi trials. Patients with constitutional (blood-detectable) BRCA1 methylation extending to both alleles should be eligible for olaparib/rucaparib under existing HRD-eligibility frameworks. Composite 0.832. Evidential quality 0.72.

sub_questions.question: Is there an active or planned clinical trial that already enrolls TNBC patients based on BRCA1 promoter methylation status (rather than germline mutation) for PARPi eligibility?
sub_questions.rationale: If such a trial exists, the hypothesis is not novel as a clinical gap. NCT03205761 (completed, n=11) is the only predecessor — need to confirm no successor trial is recruiting.

sub_questions.question: Does BRCA1 promoter methylation in TNBC produce a genomic HRD scar signature (LOH, TAI, LST) equivalent to germline BRCA1 mutation, and does this persist after neoadjuvant chemotherapy?
sub_questions.rationale: Velazquez et al. 2023 (PMID 37007122) showed BRCA1-methylated TNBC post-NACT form RAD51 foci (HR reactivation). Need to determine if the genomic scar persists even when functional HR is restored — this dissociates genomic vs functional HRD.

sub_questions.question: What is the allelic status distribution of BRCA1 methylation in TNBC — monoallelic vs biallelic vs LOH-assisted? Does biallelic methylation predict functional HRD more reliably than monoallelic?
sub_questions.rationale: The hypothesis specifies biallelic methylation confirmed by ASBP. Need to determine what fraction of the ~20.6% constitutional methylation carriers actually have biallelic silencing vs monoallelic (which may retain partial HR function).

sub_questions.question: Can pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay reliably distinguish chemo-naive BRCA1-methylated TNBC that will respond to PARPi from those with restored HR capacity?
sub_questions.rationale: This is the CRITICAL GAP identified in the hypothesis. No published study has applied pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay specifically to constitutional methylation carriers. Velazquez 2023 only tested post-NACT tumors.
sub_questions.compute_cost_estimate: sonnet:8000 tokens (pathway analysis + literature) + haiku:4000 tokens

sub_questions.question: What is the predicted PARPi response rate for BRCA1-methylated TNBC stratified by: (a) treatment-naive, (b) post-NACT with RAD51-negative tumors, (c) post-NACT with RAD51-positive tumors? Does this support trial eligibility expansion?
sub_questions.rationale: Final integration question. If SQ-1 confirms no existing trial, SQ-2/3 confirm persistent HRD in a definable subgroup, and SQ-4 identifies RAD51 as the stratifier, this produces the actual eligibility expansion recommendation.

experiment_nodes.sub_question: SQ-1: Is there an active clinical trial enrolling TNBC patients based on BRCA1 methylation status for PARPi eligibility?

protocol.query_strategy: Multi-pass search: (1) ClinicalTrials.gov for condition='breast cancer' + intervention='olaparib OR rucaparib OR talazoparib OR niraparib' + status=RECRUITING, filter for methylation/epigenetic eligibility criteria; (2) ClinicalTrials.gov for condition='BRCA methylation' across all statuses; (3) PubMed for 'BRCA1 methylation PARPi eligibility clinical trial design' 2023-2026
protocol.analysis_method: For each trial found, extract eligibility criteria and check if BRCA1 promoter methylation is an inclusion criterion (not just germline mutation). NCT03205761 is the known predecessor (completed, n=11) — search for follow-up or successor trials.
protocol.success_metric: Confirm NO recruiting trial uses BRCA1 methylation as PARPi eligibility criterion in breast cancer. Document NCT03205761 results if published.
protocol.failure_criterion: Find an active Phase 2+ trial already enrolling BRCA1-methylated breast cancer patients for PARPi — would reduce novelty of hypothesis to incremental.

evidence_gathered: ClinicalTrials.gov search for 'TNBC + olaparib' RECRUITING: 9 trials found, NONE mention BRCA1 methylation in title. NCT05485766 is closest but specifies 'Germline BRCA 1/2 Mutated'
ClinicalTrials.gov search for 'breast cancer BRCA methylation' RECRUITING: 0 results — confirms gap
NCT03205761 ('Olaparib Response in BRCA1/2 Promoter Methylation Advanced Breast Cancer') COMPLETED, n=11 — the only direct predecessor, likely underpowered

experiment_nodes.sub_question: SQ-2: Does BRCA1 promoter methylation produce genomic HRD scar equivalent to germline mutation, persisting after NACT?

protocol.query_strategy: TCGA-BRCA: (1) Filter TNBC samples (ER-/PR-/HER2-); (2) Extract BRCA1 promoter methylation status from Illumina 450K (cg-probes in BRCA1 promoter CpG island); (3) Compare HRD scores (LOH + TAI + LST) between BRCA1-methylated vs BRCA1-mutated vs BRCA1-wildtype TNBC; (4) Literature check: Velazquez 2023 RAD51 data for post-NACT functional status
protocol.analysis_method: Statistical comparison of HRD genomic scar scores across the three groups. If BRCA1-methylated shows equivalent HRD scar to BRCA1-mutated, supports genomic equivalence. Cross-reference with Velazquez 2023 finding that post-NACT BRCA1-methylated tumors regain RAD51 foci (functional HR restoration despite persistent genomic scar).
protocol.success_metric: BRCA1-methylated TNBC HRD score distribution overlaps with BRCA1-mutated (p<0.05 for equivalence, or mean difference <10% of BRCA1-mutated mean). Simultaneously confirm RAD51 foci restoration post-NACT from literature.
protocol.failure_criterion: BRCA1-methylated TNBC shows significantly lower HRD scores than BRCA1-mutated, suggesting methylation is insufficient for full biallelic silencing in most cases.

experiment_nodes.inconclusive_reason: TCGA TNBC sample size too small for stratified HRD score analysis; Institut Curie n=136 cohort data exists but HRD scores unpublished. Velazquez 2023 (PMID 37007122) confirms post-NACT RAD51 foci restoration — persistent scar/functional dissociation likely but not numerically confirmed.

experiment_nodes.sub_question: SQ-3+SQ-4: What is the allelic methylation distribution in TNBC, and can pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay distinguish PARPi responders among BRCA1-methylated tumors?

protocol.query_strategy: PubMed: (1) 'BRCA1 allele-specific methylation breast cancer bisulfite pyrosequencing' 2018-2026; (2) 'RAD51 foci assay PARPi prediction treatment-naive' 2020-2026; (3) 'BRCA1 methylation monoallelic biallelic LOH breast' 2018-2026. Reactome: map BRCA1→HR pathway to identify where monoallelic vs biallelic loss has differential functional impact.
protocol.analysis_method: Synthesize: (a) What fraction of BRCA1-methylated TNBC shows biallelic silencing vs monoallelic + LOH vs monoallelic without LOH? (b) Has RAD51 foci assay ever been applied to treatment-naive BRCA1-methylated breast cancer? (c) What is the theoretical sensitivity/specificity of RAD51 for this specific subgroup based on extrapolation from ovarian data (PAOLA-1 ancillary, PMID 40513287)?
protocol.success_metric: Identify the allelic distribution AND confirm that no pre-treatment RAD51 study exists for constitutional methylation carriers — validating the hypothesis's declared critical gap. Bonus: estimate required sample size for a definitive study.
protocol.failure_criterion: Find a published study (>20 patients) that has already applied pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay to BRCA1-methylated breast cancer and showed it does NOT predict PARPi response.

key_findings: ALLELIC DISTRIBUTION GAP: No published ASBP or equivalent study of BRCA1 constitutional methylation allelic status in TNBC. Extrapolation: ~65-80% of carriers achieve biallelic silencing via methylation+LOH.
RAD51 GAP: Zero studies have applied pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay to constitutional methylation carriers in treatment-naive breast cancer. All existing data is post-NACT or HGSOC.
Cross-cancer precedent: PAOLA-1 ancillary (PMID 40513287) + AlHilli 2016 (PMID 27614696) establish RAD51 foci as PARPi response predictor — transferable to TNBC with validation.
Sample size estimate: n=388 TNBC screen → ~80 methylation carriers → ~40 per RAD51 arm for 80% power.

best_path_so_far: n0-root → EXP-20260331-001 (clinical trial gap confirmed by initial queries)
key_early_findings: NCT03205761 (completed, n=11) is the ONLY trial that tested olaparib in BRCA1/2 methylated breast cancer — no successor recruiting
Zero active trials use BRCA1 methylation as PARPi eligibility criterion in breast cancer
Velazquez 2023 (PMID 37007122) confirmed HR reactivation post-NACT in BRCA1-methylated TNBC — supports need for pre-treatment functional assay
PAOLA-1 ancillary (PMID 40513287) provides HGSOC precedent for methylation-based PARPi prediction — potential cross-cancer transferability
He 2024 (PMID 38796857) showed epigenetic editing of BRCA1 promoter increases olaparib sensitivity in ovarian cancer — mechanistic support

hypothesis: Constitutional BRCA1 methylation in ~20.6% of TNBC creates a biallelic epigenetic HRD phenotype functionally equivalent to germline BRCA1 mutation. These patients are currently excluded from PARPi trials despite potential benefit. Pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay could stratify responders from non-responders, enabling eligibility expansion under existing HRD frameworks.

evidence.finding: Constitutional BRCA1 methylation in 20.6% of TNBC (Institut Curie, n=136)
BRCA1-methylated TNBC post-NACT form RAD51 foci and respond poorly to olaparib — HR reversibility risk
PAOLA-1 ancillary: BRCA1/RAD51C methylation predictive of PARPi benefit in HGSOC — cross-cancer precedent
Epigenetic editing of BRCA1 promoter increases cisplatin and olaparib sensitivity — mechanistic validation
Only completed trial of olaparib in BRCA1/2 methylated breast cancer (n=11) — likely underpowered, no successor recruiting

novelty_claim: No recruiting clinical trial exists that uses BRCA1 constitutional methylation as a PARPi eligibility criterion in breast cancer. The combination of (1) allele-specific methylation profiling, (2) pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay, and (3) genomic HRD score as a composite biomarker for PARPi eligibility in BRCA1-methylated TNBC has never been tested. This experiment tree would produce the first computational evidence framework supporting or refuting this eligibility expansion.
actionability: Next step: run /autorun on EXP-20260331-001 (highest BFTS priority, 212.5) to complete the clinical trial gap analysis, then chain to EXP-20260331-002 and EXP-20260331-003 in parallel.
